title: pimpinella saxifraga subsp. alpestris
intro: Pimpinella saxifraga subsp. alpestris, commonly known as Alpine burnet, is a plant species belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including digestive issues and inflammation, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Alpine burnet include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful for wound healing and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Pimpinella saxifraga subsp. alpestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
